text: Confirmed against the live Shaper code. Tapestry Shape height fields become a NEW FILL KIND that emits heightDelta only, through the existing FC-2.5 interface T-0110 already proved (zero contract changes) -- NOT a new ShaperExtrusionTechnique, because ShaperHeight.cs is an analytic, monotone-in-t, closed-form-invertible system the 3D solid marcher's Inverse() depends on, and an arbitrary imported height field has none of those properties. This matches SHAPER_THE_DESIGN.md B5 verbatim: Tapestry Shape's generators become height generators -- a fill that emits height and no colour. Tapestry Surface steel/steel_clean become new fill kinds emitting albedo. Plasma is excluded from the fill contract per B5 and ruled as a future shape-coupled emissive effect (todo 8, documentation only). Time input and coordinate switch (todo 4) both already exist generically -- ShaperFillInputs.phase01, baked per-compile exactly like Texture's animated offsetU/V, and ShaperFillSpace Stamped/Fixed -- so I am reusing them rather than building new mechanisms.
